platform.title: Which Geely backend?
platform.description:
Pick the platform your account is on.

Existing backend: the current Geely Global integration (email + code, per-device certificate).

New Geely EM platform: the backend behind the new Geely EM app (email + password, Zeekr cloud) - experimental. Complete the app's setup on your phone first.

user.title: Geely Connect
user.description: Unofficial community integration - not affiliated with Geely. Pick the backend your account uses (default: the existing Geely backend, email + code). Accounts on the new Geely EM app platform (email + password, experimental) pick that option instead - complete the app's setup on your phone first.\n\nPolling mode decides how often the car is contacted. Geely allows one session per account, so every poll briefly signs the phone app out - pick Manual if that bothers you.

code.title: Enter the code from your inbox
code.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Paste it here.

pick_vehicle.title: Pick a vehicle
pick_vehicle.description: Your Geely account has multiple vehicles. Pick the one to add. Already-configured vehicles are not shown.

zeekr_login.title: Geely EM platform (new app)
zeekr_login.description:
Experimental: the new-platform backend is still being verified on real cars, so treat it as beta.

Enter the email and password you use with the new Geely app. If you have not done so yet, open the new Geely app on your phone first and complete the setup there (the app will walk you through setting a password and linking your vehicle). This integration logs in with email + password only.

Storing the password lets the session renew itself automatically (as the app does). It is your Geely account password: it is redacted from logs and diagnostics, and encrypted at rest if you add a 'geely_password_key' to secrets.yaml (otherwise it is stored in plain text in Home Assistant's storage). Uncheck to re-authenticate manually about every 2 days instead.

data.store_password: Store my password so the session renews automatically

zeekr_pick.title: Pick a vehicle
zeekr_pick.description: Your account has multiple vehicles. Pick the one to add.

error.send_code_failed: Failed to send the email code. Try again in a minute.
error.captcha_unreachable: Home Assistant could not reach Geely's captcha server (captcha4.geely.com). Setup runs from the Home Assistant machine, and this host is in mainland China - check that your network or DNS is not blocking it (Pi-hole/AdGuard blocklists, router geo-filters), then try again.
error.network_unreachable: Home Assistant could not reach the Geely EM platform (zeekrlife.com). Check the network and try again.
error.invalid_code: That code wasn't accepted. It may have expired (codes are single-use).
error.invalid_credentials: That email or password wasn't accepted. If your account is new to the new Geely app, open the app on your phone first and complete the setup there (it sets your password and links your vehicle), then try again.
error.no_vehicles: Login succeeded but no vehicles were found on this account. Open the new Geely app on your phone and make sure your vehicle is linked there, then try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This Geely vehicle is already set up.
abort.all_configured: All vehicles on this account are already configured.
abort.cert_failed: Failed to provision the per-device mTLS certificate. Check the logs.
abort.wrong_region: This Geely account is served by a regional backend this integration has no credentials for. It supports the EU/International, North-American and APAC clouds; other regions need their own app credentials, which are not public. The log line names the region that was detected.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfigured. The entry was updated and reloaded.
abort.unknown: Something went wrong. Check the logs.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: Re-authentication used a different Geely account than the one this entry was created with. Sign in with the original account, or remove the entry and add the vehicle again.

init.title: Options
init.description:
Change how often Home Assistant polls the car, the tire-pressure unit and which entities are exposed.

Eco, Normal and Live poll on a timer, from least to most often. Manual never polls on its own: data refreshes only when you press the Refresh Data button, call homeassistant.update_entity, or send a command to the car. Nothing is contacted in between, so the phone app stays signed in - but values stay as old as your last sync.

data.full_exposure: Expose every raw field (adds ~180 diagnostic entities)
data.zeekr_enc_vin: Vehicle token for the new platform (x-vin) - advanced. Usually derived automatically at setup; set this only to override it, or if your app build is not yet known
